{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
fraction_severe = (df_dedup['severity'] == 'severe').mean()

fraction_severe"}
